title: Voice memo: on the way in

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Okay. Wednesday. I'm driving in, so this is me talking to the car.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Big one today is Ducal Freight at ten thirty. Paris Duke, their VP of operations. That's our first real customer call for Schema Bridge, so, um, mostly listen. Find out how their inspections actually work before I pitch anything.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Then Romeo at three. I want to walk out of that with field versioning settled. Who owns what. It's been the open question since Monday, and it's still an empty line in the spec.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Which, right, spec v2 gets written today. Today, not tomorrow. I said Wednesday, so it's Wednesday.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Standup at nine thirty. Keep it short. Ten minutes, tops. Everybody's got real work today, me included.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Oh, and the Paris flight. For the trade show. I said I'd book it Monday and I, uh, didn't. Book it today. Seriously, Juliet.
